title: Northern Africa Countries
instruction: Look at the map of Northern Africa (countries 1 to 6) and answer:
hint: 1=Sudan, 2=Egypt, 3=Libya, 4=Tunisia, 5=Algeria, 6=Morocco. Egypt is #2 and Sudan is south (#1)!

items.text: On the map of Northern Africa, which country is labeled with number 2?
items.explanation: Number 2 is Egypt, located in the northeast by the Red Sea and Mediterranean Sea.

items.text: On the map of Northern Africa, which country is labeled with number 1?
items.explanation: Number 1 is Sudan, located directly south of Egypt.

items.text: On the map of Northern Africa, which country is labeled with number 3?
items.explanation: Number 3 is Libya, located directly west of Egypt.

items.text: On the map of Northern Africa, which small country is labeled with number 4?
items.explanation: Number 4 is Tunisia, the small country at the northern coast.

items.text: On the map of Northern Africa, which large country is labeled with number 5?
items.explanation: Number 5 is Algeria, the large country between Morocco and Libya.

items.text: On the map of Northern Africa, which country is labeled with number 6 on the far west?
items.explanation: Number 6 is Morocco, on the far west along the Atlantic Ocean.

items.text: Which number on the map shows Egypt?
items.explanation: Egypt is number 2 on the map.

items.text: Which number on the map shows Sudan, directly south of Egypt?
items.explanation: Sudan is directly south (under) Egypt, labeled with number 1.

items.text: Which number on the map shows Libya, directly west of Egypt?
items.explanation: Libya is number 3 on the map, bordering Egypt to the west.

items.text: Which number on the map shows Morocco on the far west coast?
items.explanation: Morocco is number 6 on the western edge of Northern Africa.

items.text: Which small country at the northern tip is labeled with number 4?
items.explanation: Tunisia is the small country at the northern tip labeled with number 4.

items.text: Which country is directly south of Egypt (number 2) on the map?
items.explanation: Sudan (1) is located directly south of Egypt (2).

items.text: Which country is directly to the west of Egypt (number 2) on the map?
items.explanation: Libya (3) shares the western border with Egypt (2).

items.text: What do the lines separating Egypt (2) and Libya (3) represent?
items.explanation: The lines drawn between countries on a map are borders.
